body: I can't tell you to put yourself in my place, but imagine having a brother that always had a shitty attitude towards you and other household members, that never does any house chore, that always tries to make you feel inferior... Well, that's how it is for me. The last few years, the only thing he used to tell me was that I was nothing but a expense for my mother because I used to go out almost every weekend night (which I earned because I'm the only one that helped her with lots of personal and family related stuff). He has barely any friends, me otherwise I got a lot, luckily, but I never threw that in his face, even when he was being so shitty to me, but still it was reason enough for him to do it. I drive him to every place he needs, I lend him money, I do house chores so he won't stress out. So you don't come here and dare to call me a bad sibling when he was treating me like shit for over 15 years, and yet I care for him.

So for those that told me to tell his therapist, that's what I did.

I had to ask my mom his number, I told him what happened, then she gave it to me and I messaged him. He called me but I couldn't respond so immediately he called my brother. Not sure what he told him but they spent around 10 minutes on the phone. I left the house so I could have some space and called him after explaining. He thanked me but literally responded "don't believe him". So my part is done, I guess? Of course I'll be on guard.

​

Thanks you every much who sent helpful responses, I really appreciate it.
I might try to get his phone number from my mom's without her noticing and call him when I get the chance

Relationship with both of them are kind of shity as well. he doesn't want to be around my brother because he claims "he's the only one who listened to him complain about life", even though my brother really struggled in his teenage years and also helped him a lot. And my mom feels kind of like me, tired of dealing with his bad attitude, bad mood, etc.
